tools.name: generate_system
tools.title: Generate a solar system
tools.description: Create a deterministic cartoon solar-system-like world from a seed: a sun, hand-painted planets (some with moons) on wobbly storybook orbits, and drifting friends. The same seed and planet count always return the same system.

seed.description: Integer seed for the world. Omit for a fresh random seed. Reuse a seed to get the exact same system back.

planetCount.description: How many planets the system should have (1-8). Defaults to 4; values outside the range are clamped.

tools.name: list_sprites
tools.title: List sprite cast
tools.description: List the full cast of hand-painted gouache sprites the generator assembles systems from — suns, planets, moons and drifting friends (rockets, astronauts, UFOs and more) — with image URLs.

tools.name: list_backgrounds
tools.title: List sky backgrounds
tools.description: List the hand-painted gouache starfield backgrounds the app can use as the sky, with full-size and small-screen image URLs.
